name: BLX-α with α = 0.5
lesson: With α = 0.5 the children of BLX-α may fall outside the box spanned by their parents, so the search can expand beyond it.
lookFor: Mutation is off, the same seed and landscape as the preset with α = 0. Here the box around the population grows in some generations, and Run until stop pauses at generation 6, within ε of the optimum. Compare the two runs in the Landscape view. This is one seed: with seeds 1 to 100, 66 runs reach ε with α = 0.5 against 37 with α = 0.
